_about: Everything you can grow or forage, as plain data. The game reads this file; so can any other engine (it maps one-to-one onto data tables). Hours are game hours. Money is dollars.

serum._about: Grow serum: one bottle brings one watered, growing plot to harvest at once. Bought at the General Store; one is also given for each job of the day.

oyster.name: Oyster
oyster.use: Goes into a sandwich as a mushroom melt, worth $3 more.

lionsmane.name: Lion's mane
lionsmane.use: Clear Head tea. For four hours you learn faster, read what people want before you ask, cannot be pickpocketed, and timing games slow down.

reishi.name: Reishi
reishi.use: Old Soul tea. For a day none of your bars can fall below a tenth, so you cannot collapse.

cordyceps.name: Cordyceps
cordyceps.use: Zombie Legs. Sprinting costs no Energy for one hour. Then the bill arrives all at once.

foxfire.name: Foxfire
foxfire.use: Glow jars. Set them out as camp lanterns that need no power, or carry one and wild mushrooms nearby show themselves at night.

goldcap.name: Golden caps
goldcap.on: a tub in the dark of your tent
goldcap.use: The Trip. Where you are, who is with you and how you feel decide how it goes. One handful a day.

chanterelle.name: Chanterelle
chanterelle.tell: Blunt, forked ridges that run down the stem. Not true gills.

jack.name: Jack-o'-lantern
jack.tell: True gills: thin, crowded and sharp as a knife edge. It glows faintly at night.

morel.name: Morel
morel.looks: A wrinkled brown cap on a pale stem
morel.tell: Completely hollow from the tip of the cap to the bottom of the stem.
morel.use: A morel melt, worth $5 more. The best sandwich on the lot.

falsemorel.name: False morel
falsemorel.looks: A wrinkled brown cap on a pale stem
falsemorel.tell: Cottony and chambered inside, not hollow. The cap is lobed like a brain.

chicken.name: Chicken of the woods
chicken.looks: Bright orange and yellow shelves on a dead trunk
chicken.tell: Tiny pores underneath, no gills at all, and it only grows on wood.
chicken.use: A whole meal. Eat it to fill most of your Nourishment.

puffball.name: Puffball
puffball.looks: A smooth white ball in the grass
puffball.tell: Pure white and solid all the way through, like a marshmallow.
puffball.use: A smoke bomb. Throw it to lose security: Buzzkill drops, and nobody can pick your pocket for an hour.

turkeytail.name: Turkey tail
turkeytail.looks: Thin, striped fans on a fallen log
turkeytail.tell: White underneath with pores too small to see, and velvety bands of colour on top.
turkeytail.use: Iron broth. For a day, rain, cold and a bad mushroom cannot make you ill.

ghostcap.name: Ghost cap
ghostcap.looks: A small, pale mushroom that seems to be lit from inside
ghostcap.tell: No colour anywhere. It fruits only at night, after rain.
ghostcap.use: The rare one. Its finished page is worth a skill point by itself; the Elder will want to see it.
